{{Top|leg}}
'''Imobilin''' was a drug that was used in many military [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]] during the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in order to keep badly-injured patients from causing more harm to themselves.

==Characteristics==
Imobilin acted as a paralytic, limiting a patient's ability to move about without causing other injuries. It had no known side effects.
